It's the perfect hub for distribution.|Vel Sartha|}} '''Aldhani''' was a [[planet]] located in the [[Cademimu sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories]] of [[the galaxy]]. During the [[Imperial Era]], [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]] joined the [[Aldhani rebel infiltration team]] for a [[Aldhani heist|mission]] to rob the [[Aldhani dam|Imperial base]] there. ==Description== Aldhani was a terrestrial [[planet]] located in the [[Cademimu sector]]. It featured [[Highlands (Aldhani)|Highlands]] with rolling hills, tall [[mountain]]s, and lakes and rivers. The planet also had its contrasting [[Lowlands]]. With a type I [[atmosphere]] breathable to [[human]]s, Aldhani saw much cloudy weather. Every three [[Standard year|years]], to the thousandth of a [[Standard second|second]], Aldhani would pass through a belt of billions of [[crystal]]s, which would swarm the atmosphere and cover the sky with a blanket of [[meteor shower]]s. Despite having a type I atmosphere, the dilapidated [[pirate]] [[droid]] [[SM-33]], who visited Aldhani at some point, described the planet as a "sulfurous bog" to the younglings [[Wim]], [[Neel]], [[Fern]], and [[KB]]{{SkeletonCrew|Way, Way Out Past the Barrier}} around [[9 ABY]].{{SkeletonCrewDate}} ==History== ===The death of a culture=== {{Quote|The Empire came in thirteen years ago and liberated the air base, Alkenzi, 50 klicks west of here. They quickly discovered the unique storage possibilities of the caverns, claimed the land for the Emperor, and dammed up Nasma Klain, the sacred river.|Vel Sartha briefs Cassian Andor on Aldhani's Imperial garrison|}} Centuries prior to [[Imperial Era|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire]], the Aldhani Highlands were covered by hundreds of settlements. The Dhanis there celebrated the tri-yearly [[meteor]] shower, a sacred event which they called the [[Eye of Aldhani|''Mak-ani bray Dhani'']] "Eye of Aldhani," at the [[Nasma Brani]] temple in the Highlands valley of [[Akti Amaugh]]. In [[18 BBY]]{{AndorDate|104}} The episode establishes that the [[Galactic Empire]] arrived on the [[planet]] thirteen [[Standard year|years]] before, which corresponds to [[18 BBY]], [[Gorn]] began serving at the [[Aldhani dam]] seven years before, which corresponds to [[12 BBY]], and the [[Aldhani rebel infiltration team|rebel team]] there had been preparing for five [[Standard month|months]], placing their arrival on the [[planet]] between [[6 BBY]] and 5 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|BBY]]. the Empire arrived at Aldhani and liberated the [[Alkenzi Air Base]] fifty-two [[kilometer]]s west of Akti Amaugh. Drawn by the world's exposure to [[orbit]]al micro-crystal deposits, it was not long before they discovered the sensor-disrupting geological qualities of the [[cave]]rns at Akti Amaugh. The land was thus claimed for the [[Galactic Emperor|Emperor]], [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine]],''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' and the river there, [[Nasma Klain]], was blocked by a new [[Aldhani dam|dam]] that headquartered as the [[Aldhani Garrison|Imperial garrison]]. The dam became a depot for supplies, weapons, and the payroll for Aldhani's [[sector]] in pre-packed high-density [[aurodium]] ingots. The local Dhani people were displaced after being bribed with [[alcohol]] and relocated to a warmer area downhill, a strategy that diminished their cultural cohesion and ultimately resulted in the loss of their homeland.{{YouTube|video=dPLJESDwpU0|text=Andor S2 Emmys Q&A - Tony Gilroy - Dan Gilroy|channel=backstorymagazine2757|name=Backstory Magazine|date=2025-08-25}} Upon its occupation of Aldhani, the Empire established an [[Enterprise Zone]] in the Lowlands with newly built [[City|towns]] and [[Factory|factories]]. Despite the Dhanis valuing certain areas for sacred rituals, the Empire turned the territory that they took over into tactically advantageous positions for their base and prohibited the Dhanis from settling there. Over the course of thirteen years, 40,000 [[Dhani]]s living in the Highlands were driven from their settlements in the sacred valleys and relocated to the Enterprise Zone down south, leaving only a scattered few [[Ghoat-herder|shepherds]] and wanderers up north. With the Dhani population primarily working in the factories, Aldhani became an established distribution hub. [[File:Aldhani-pilgrims.png|thumb|left|300px|Despite Imperial prohibitions, many Dhanis completed the pilgrimage to the sacred valley.]] The Dhani's continued to make a ten-[[Standard day|day]] pilgrimage to the Akti Amaugh valley every three years to see the Eye of Aldhani. While the attendance initially numbered 15,000 at the start of the Imperial occupation, the Empire made measures to whittle their numbers down, placing a series "[[Comfort Unit]]s" along the pilgrimage route like shelters and taverns to siphon off Dhanis not as devoted to the pilgrimage. Knowing the Dhanis would refuse, the Imperials offered them [[transport]]s to save them the ten-day walk, keeping up the illusion of offering hospitality. In the meantime, an Imperial viewing festival of the Eye of Aldhani was promoted in the Enterprise Zone over the [[Standard decade|decade]] that the clearances took place. These measures were highly successful, as by 5 BBY only about sixty individuals completed the full pilgrimage.{{Andor|The Eye}} ===Plans and plots=== {{Quote|Looks just like your model.''"
"''Should do. I've had plenty of time to study, and we've been sneaking up here for months.|Cassian Andor and Karis Nemik|}} From [[12 BBY]], the [[Imperial officer]] [[Lieutenant]] [[Gorn]] was assigned to the dam serving under the [[garrison]]'s [[commanding officer]], [[Commandant]] [[Jayhold Beehaz]]. Gorn at some point fell in love with a Dhani woman, but was then reprimanded by his superiors and lost a promotion, as well as the woman. Between [[6 BBY]] and [[5 BBY]], [[Luthen Rael]], a rebel [[spy]] who was building up a [[Axis network|network]] of anti-Imperial groups, helped put together an infiltration team led by [[Vel Sartha]],{{Andor|Announcement}} the cousin of the Imperial [[Senator]] [[Mon Mothma]],{{Andor|Nobody's Listening!}} in a plot to rob the payroll stored at the Aldhani dam. The team comprised of Sartha, [[Cinta Kaz]], [[Taramyn Barcona]], [[Karis Nemik]], and [[Arvel Skeen]], all apparent rebel idealists. The team also liaised with Gorn, who had lost his taste in the Empire and chosen to be their inside man. Over the next five [[Standard month|months]], the rebel team operated from a [[Vel Sartha's camp|camp]] posing as [[Ghoat]]-herders. Over that time, they snuck up to the dam to scout the Imperial base, on top of meeting with Gorn and receiving a detailed plan of the garrison and how it operated. With their reconnaissance, the team formulated a heist plan, which used the upcoming iteration of the Eye of Aldhani as their cover, and prepared by learning the details to great accuracy and training to pose as Imperial guards and shoot. Nemik made an accurate model of the dam itself and the vault to help visualize their plan. Rael kept contact with Sartha and grew worried that the team would not quite be able to pull off the heist. In 5 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|BBY]], he recruited the fugitive [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]] and paid him to join the team, hoping that his skills in [[pilot]]ing and more would raise the team's odds. In the meantime, plans had arisen for a relocation of the air base to the Akti Amaugh valley from Alkenzi as the next step of the Imperial occupation. [[Colonel]] [[Soden Petigar]], an Imperial [[engineer]] from the [[Galaxy|galactic]] [[capital]] of [[Coruscant]]. Was set to arrive at the Imperial dam ahead of the Eye of Aldhani to begin his survey of the area. As a result, [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter|TIE fighter]] patrols from Alkenzi became more frequent across the Highland valleys. ===Final tweaks=== Upon recruiting Andor, Rael took his new associate to Aldhani to meet with Sartha. Having barely gotten the message for a meeting, Sartha took a full day to get to the rendezvous due to the increased patrols of [[Stone Valley]]. She was unaware of the new recruit for her team, who took on the alias "Clem" upon Rael's request. Telling Andor to stay inside, Rael went to speak with Sartha, who was angry at the news of a last minute addition to her team, especially as he was a paid mercenary. Justifying "Clem" as critical for the team's success, Rael gave his associate an ultimatum to follow through and lie about the nature of the new team member, reassuring Sartha that rented help could be disposable if they became a problem. Rael introduced "Clem" to Sartha and departed for Coruscant. Sartha led Andor back to her teams camp through the night. During the journey, she raised questions on Andor's arm injury and told him to keep quiet about Rael, intending on pretending to the team that it was her idea. They also spoke about Aldhani's Imperial forces, which "Clem" had not been told about, and took cover when two TIE fighters passed by. When the pair stopped at the remnants of a cleared out village, Sartha informed Andor about the Highland clearances and which locals remained in the region. Sartha and "Clem" reached the camp the next day, the new arrival being introduced to the other rebels. Sartha pushed her story on the addition and brushed past any signs of protest from Barcona and Skeen. While Kaz tended to Andor's arm, the rest of them talked over the new change, with Sartha reassuring her team that she trusted "Clem." Gorn later arrived for a plan briefing, immediately being told of the new team member. Angry about not being informed beforehand, the lieutenant argued with Sartha on the last minute change of circumstances. The full team gathered for a meeting, where a model of the Aldhani dam made by Nemik was used to explain the base and the plan to infiltrate it and steal the credits inside, using a resident [[Max-7 Rono box freighter]]. Andor confirmed he could fly the [[freighter]] but expressed doubt on its capabilities to be a getaway vehicle given the presence of the Alkenzi Air Base. The other team members then explained the Eye of Aldhani celestial event. Amazed at this cover strategy, "Clem" gave his full commitment to the plan. ===The heist=== The team invaded on the night of a Dhani celebration of The Eye, a natural phenomenon that lit the sky once every three years. Following the heist, every single Aldhani that attended the ceremony and beyond was rounded up and detained. ==Society and culture== Aldhani was inhabited by the Dhanis, a cultural group of humans. Centuries prior to [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] takeover, the hills of the planet were covered by hundreds of settlements that housed at least 40,000 Dhanis across the highlands. However, after about a decade of the Empire's presence, the Dhanis were cleared out and relocated to an [[Enterprise Zone]] in the [[Lowlands]] in the southern region of the planet. Commandant [[Jayhold Beehaz]] believed the Dhanis were unable to hold multiple ideas simultaneously leading to them being vulnerable to manipulation. In 5 BBY, several Dhanis participated in the traditional ten-day trek from the lowlands to the Akti Amaugh to see the ''Mak-ani bray Dhani'', or the [[Eye of Aldhani]], a celestial event that occurs once every three years. ==Behind the scenes== {{Quote|We were intrigued with the idea that we could build a planet around the Scottish Highlands because so many of the ''Star Wars'' planets are desert or ice, so it was interesting to find a tangible landscape that could form a different version of a planet. If you look at the dam, it looks like Darth Vader's mask. The notion of everything that we're trying to do with the series is to suggest that the Empire was a bit of a blight on any landscape, so it was perfect.|Luke Hull|{{Getty|url=thewaltdisneystudios/allaccess#!asset/gppr5wpqgb4t74974f8s|text=ANDOR Production Brief V3 FINAL 8-04-22|author=[[Gina McIntyre|McIntyre, Gina]]|date=2022-08-04}}}} Aldhani first appeared in "[[Aldhani (episode)|Aldhani]]," the fourth episode of ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'', which aired on [[September 28]], [[2022]].{{Twitter|starwars|status/1557442379975573504|[[Star Wars]]|date=2022-08-10|quote=This is what revolution looks like. Watch #Andor, a Star Wars Original Series, streaming only on @DisneyPlus September 21.|archivedate=20220810191942}} The planet was first pictured in the form of concept art in the sizzle reel for the series, which was released on [[December 10]], [[2020]].{{SWYouTube|gSW-pARyP-M|Sizzle Reel | Andor | Disney+|sw_url=video/sizzle-andor}} It was first mentioned in a costume reveal at [[Wikipedia:San Diego Comic-Con|San Diego Comic-Con]].{{SW|url=news/lucasfilm-pavilion-sdcc-2022|text=SDCC 2022: ''Andor'' Costumes Revealed at the Lucasfilm Pavilion}} In the production brief, the planet was called "Al-Dhani." [[File:CassianAndorVelSarthaConceptArt.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Concept art of Cassian Andor and Vel Sartha Scenes hiding from TIE fighters on Aldhani by Chester Carr]] There were originally going to be six or seven thousand Dhanis in the valley on Aldhani, but this was made impossible due to [[Wikipedia:COVID-19|COVID-19]] and an economic hardship. To solve this, the Dhani culture ended up being wound down, which became the dominant aspect. This led to a monologue, the concept of the engineer{{WebCite|url=https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/tv/tv-features/andor-tony-gilroy-talks-luthen-rael-monologue-easter-eggs-1235258961|text=‘Andor' Creator Tony Gilroy Talks Luthen Rael's Future and Being Surprised by Certain Easter Eggs|author=Davids, Brian|date=2022-11-09|work=[[Wikipedia:The Hollywood Reporter|''The Hollywood Reporter'']]|archivedate=20221109220924}} [[Soden Petigar]], and a new approach to the planet's shabbiness. Concept artist [[Chester Carr]] created concept art of [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]] and Vel Sartha Scenes hiding from TIE fighters on Aldhani.{{SW|url=andor-concept-art-gallery|text=Concept Art Gallery | Andor}} Carr also created concept art of the Aldhani dam{{Instagram|username=chestbearman|url=p/CliqBBbI82v|name=[[Chester Carr]]|date=2022-11-29|quote=@andorofficial released some more concepts - here's one I worked on for the Al Dhani heist episodes.|archivedate=20230308213214}} and Sartha's team looking at a model of the dam in their camp. Scenes on Aldhani were filmed at the [[Wikipedia:Cruachan Power Station|Cruachan Dam]] and the surrounding [[mountain]]s in the [[Wikipedia:Scottish Highlands|Scottish Highlands]]. According to [[Faye Marsay]], the actress who plays Sartha, scenes on Aldhani were filmed during the middle of the [[Wikipedia:COVID-19 pandemic|COVID-19 pandemic]]. The actors had to follow COVID guidelines.{{WebCite|url=https://www.slashfilm.com/1082395/andors-faye-marsay-talks-preparing-to-play-vel-sartha-the-real-rebellions-that-inspired-her-more-exclusive-interview|text=Andor's Faye Marsay Talks Preparing To Play Vel Sartha, The Real Rebellions That Inspired Her & More [Exclusive Interview]|author=Anderton, Ethan|date=2022-11-02|work=[[Wikipedia:/Film|''/Film'']]|archivedate=20221102170524}} [[File:AldhaniDamBTS.png|thumb|left|300px|The Cruachan Dam was found by Luke Hull and used as a filming location for Aldhani.]] Production designer [[Luke Hull]] and his team were intrigued with building a planet around the [[Wikipedia:Scotland|Scottish]] Highlands. Hull was interested in finding a tangible landscape that could be used a different version of a planet. He found the Cruachan Dam in Scotland.{{Twitter|NatGeoTravel|status/1575274368460111874|[[Wikipedia:National Geographic Traveler|Nat Geo Travel]]|date=2022-09-28|quote=From post-war Scotland to 1920s Amsterdam, explore the locations that inspired the architecture of #Andor, an original series from Star Wars, now streaming only on @DisneyPlus.|archivedate=20220929235420}} He thought the location was perfect because the [[dam]] looked like [[Darth Vader's armor|Darth Vader's mask]], suggesting that the Empire was a blight on every landscape. Scenes in the Aldhani dam were filmed in the Cruachan Dam.{{Instagram|username=bencruachaninn|url=p/CiAmNIvK47K|name=Ben Cruachan Inn|date=2022-09-02|quote=Lots of excitement with the release of #starwars series #Andor Here's some more snaps from the trailers! and more to follow! Come join us on the 21st September for celebrations. More details to follow! Soon.|archivedate=20221013000727}} For the scenes filmed in [[Wikipedia:Pitlochry|Pitlochry]], Scotland, [[Diego Luna]] and the other actors walked for hours up a mountain to set up one shot.{{WebCite|url=https://www.empireonline.com/tv/news/star-wars-andor-doesnt-use-volume-says-tony-gilroy-exclusive|text=Andor Doesn't Use Star Wars' Volume Video Wall: ‘We're Old-School,' Says Tony Gilroy – Exclusive Image|author=Travis, Ben|date=2022-08-01|work=[[Wikipedia:Empire (magazine)|''Empire'']]|archivedate=20220801153835}} The episode "[[The Eye]]" originally started with Jayhold Beehaz's speech, but there was too much bad weather during filming, so the crew ended up embracing the look. The crew felt that the scene of [[Karis Nemik]] telling Cassian Andor he could not sleep could not go after the speech, so the two scenes ended up getting swapped.{{WebCite|url=https://www.indiewire.com/2022/12/andor-interview-tony-gilroy-john-gilroy-1234785978/amp|text=‘Andor' Swapped Two Scenes – and It Sparked a Rebel's Emotional Fire|author=Shachat, Sarah|date=2022-12-02|work=[[Wikipedia:IndieWire|IndieWire]]|archivedate=20221202162056}} Costume designer [[Michael Wilkinson]] and his team spent a long time establishing carefully curated palettes of textures and colors for Aldhani to make the information clear for the audience.{{WebCite|url=https://collider.com/andor-interview-michael-wilkinson-star-wars|text='Andor's Costume Designer on Creating Cassian's Wardrobe and Returning for Season 2|author=Lovitt, Maggie|date=2022-11-14|work=[[Wikipedia:Collider (website)|''Collider'']]|archivedate=20221114190034}} The Aldhani shepherds' costumes were made from natural fabrics, and Wilkinson made the costumes dark, textural, and organic.{{SW|url=news/dressing-the-galaxy-designer-michael-wilkinson-defines-the-look-of-andor-s-costumes|text=Dressing the Galaxy: Designer Michael Wilkinson Defines the Look of Andor's Costumes}} The costumes were then shipped to Scotland. Wilkinson worked with many local background performers. A team of people was sent there to fit and create the background characters, uniforms, and nomadic mountain culture of the Dhanis. For the sequence showing the Dhanis, Wilkinson's team fitted a large array of people.
